reason: 'Pale' is lost. Chestnut colour alone is not pale chestnut-brown.
Foliated means bearing leaves, which is the same as leafy.
Orthotropic means growing vertically. The constraint to stem, shoot system and branch is right.
A syncarpous fruit has fused carpels, and the fruit constraint is already there. Syncarp can also mean a multiple fruit, so this is not certain.
Hypocrepiform means horseshoe-shaped. Salverform is hypocrateriform, a different word. No class for the right shape was found.
A collar-like part forms a ring around something, so ring shaped fits.
Not fused means free.
Without colleters means colleter absent.
The target is a leaf midvein. On a sepal, bract or petal the midrib is not a leaf midvein.
Supra-axillary means above the axil. Extra-axillary only means outside the axil, so the position is lost.
Furry means covered with soft hairs, so hairy fits.
Immaculate means without spots, so not spotted fits.
Pointed is the general class that includes a long-apiculate tip. Some detail is lost but nothing false is said.
The calyx is made of sepals, so calyx-like means sepal-like.
Lamellose means with thin plate-like ridges, so ridged fits roughly.
Not flaring means not flared.
Huge is a large size, so increased size fits.
The arcuate (curved) form of the ascent is lost. The curved form would need a second quality.
Long-tailed means caudate.
Not glabrous is the negation of glabrous.
Unthickened means not thickened.
Columellate is a pollen exine term (rod-like columellae). PO columella is a different structure, for example the moss capsule columella.
Endospermless means endosperm absent.
Declining means bent or directed downward, which is close to descending.
Reticulate is lost. The word means a net pattern with pits, so it needs both reticulate and alveolate.
Weakly defined means indistinct, so inconspicuous fits.
Directed forward means pointing toward the apex, which is antrorse.
Excised means cut out, not a notched apex. Emarginate is a specific shape of a tip and the two are not the same.
Honeycomb-like means alveolate.
Packed means crowded.
A running rhizome, rootstock or stolon is a creeping one. The constraint is right.
Tattered means irregularly torn, which is lacerate.
Virgately branched means with wand-like branches, which is virgate.
Psilate means smooth, mostly used for pollen and seeds.
Tail-like means caudate.
Accuminate is a misspelling of acuminate.
Lozenge-shaped means rhomboid.
Not broadened is the negation of dilated or expanded. The match is rough.
Not connate is the negation of connate.
Not spine-tipped is the negation of spine-tipped.
Pimpled means with small bumps, which is papillose.
Pitless means not pitted, which is not foveate.
A pseudoraceme is a raceme-like inflorescence.
Gland-covered means the part carries glands. The 'covered' (many glands) part is lost, but the gland is there.
Equal-sized means equal.
Interlacing veins form a net, which is reticulate. It could also mean anastomosing.
The bearer (nerves or veins) is lost. The meaning is that the venation is inconspicuous, so it needs the nerve or vein as bearer.
Not septate means septum absent.
Ear-shaped means auriculate.
Without buttresses means not buttressed.
